doc.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Thanks and goodbye; honorary degree at Hamilton
summary: They look forward to his Hamilton degree and close.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well thanks again for your time and I look forward to your next visit to Hamilton for your degree.
Well I’m looking forward to that. I absolutely am looking forward to receiving that degree. And I’m sure we’ll talk before then.
